body:
## Description
Detect disconnected or isolated sections of a circuit that aren't connected to the main circuit or ground.

## Problem
Isolated subcircuits can't be properly simulated and often indicate wiring mistakes or incomplete designs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify disconnected circuit sections
- [ ] Find nodes/components not reachable from ground
- [ ] Detect floating subcircuits (no ground connection)
- [ ] Provide visualization of isolated sections
- [ ] Suggest connection points

## Technical Approach
- Graph connectivity analysis
- Connected components algorithm
- Path finding from ground node

## Priority
High - Helps users identify wiring mistakes quickly
title: Feature: Isolated Subcircuit Detection
